status: UNVERIFIED. Not shipped, not signed, never rendered. Moved out of packages/doorway/src/routes.nl.json on 2026-11-07 (security review item 2).
why: Each record below has verifiedBy, verifiedAt and expiresAt null (or no sourceUrl). The Door renders a confidentiality claim only when isRenderableConfidence() in packages/core/src/route.js is true, so none of these was ever on screen; but the signed production bundle used to contain them, where anyone who opened the file could read them.
toShip: To use one of these claims: a named person at the service must confirm the wording in writing; then add a conf record with text, basis, an https sourceUrl, verifiedBy, verifiedAt (within 12 months) and a future expiresAt to that route in routes.nl.json, run npm run sign, then npm run check:routes. Until then it stays here.

conf.text: Anonymous and free. Callers do not need to identify themselves. Offlimits states that nothing is reported to law enforcement; the general Dutch duty to report acute danger does not extend to anonymous helpline conversations (as stated by Offlimits / organisers' legal-confidentiality data).
Confidential helpline run by the Lucy Faithfull Foundation. Sourced from service guarantee.
Confidential helpline guidance provided by Stop It Now coalition with narrow statutory exceptions for imminent child harm.
Confidential prevention helpline operated by the Australian Centre for Child Protection (ACCP).
Free, anonymous national helpline operated by Karolinska Institutet. Protected under Swedish healthcare statutory secrecy (OSL 25:1).

Free, confidential prevention programme for people who are attracted to children and want help before anything happens. Treatment is confidential; the programme states it does not report participants to police.
